title: Cineverse Celebrates Halfway to Halloween with Harrowing Holiday Horror Flick, Silent Night, Deadly Night Exclusively Streaming On SCREAMBOX
summary: Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, has announced today that SCREAMBOX will be the exclusive streaming home of Silent Night, Deadly Night , starting on April 28th. The film is currently available on digital EST/TVOD and is Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes. The unique take on the iconic '80s holiday franchise quickly became a fan-favorite, and now streaming audiences can experience the bloody absurdity of Silent Night, Deadly Night on SCREAMBOX. The film is written and directed by Mike P. Nelson ( Wrong Turn, V/H/S/85 ) and stars Rohan Campbell as Billy and Ruby Modine as Pamela, along with Mark Acheson, David Lawrence Brown, and David Tomlinson. A twisted reimagining of the controversial classic – After witnessing his parents' brutal murder on Christmas Eve, Billy grows up to deliver an annual spree of holiday violence.
